threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still wait for the bus at the stop instead of just walking to the nearest corner. That’s a dead giveaway.
Heard a guy on the 47 confidently argue that the universe is just a side effect of a giant cat's dream. Typical Bermondsey night, I guess.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I heard three languages arguing over the last kebab at 3 AM outside Bäcker Silberstein. Classic Neukölln chaos.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a silent disco in a burned-out building, dancing in the moonlight while the street buzzes with life outside.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: A true local knows which taco trucks run out of al pastor before 6 PM and won't dare to suggest a burrito from anywhere but La Taqueria.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 47 stuck for 20 mins behind a kid with a skateboard taking selfies on the tracks. Just another day in the TL.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often miss that the best tapas spots are tucked away in the quiet streets, not just on the busy plazas. The locals know where the real flavors are.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they still double-check the metro map every time they enter the station, especially around Fontana.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still queue politely at the bus stop, while everyone else just huddles and pushes in like it’s a game of Tetris.
Caught a night bus from Brixton to Peckham; a guy was serenading the driver with 90s R&B. Strangely, it worked. Driver even smiled.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a group of kids using a broken bus stop sign as a makeshift basketball hoop. Only in Neukölln do you get creative with the city's leftovers.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you grab a currywurst at 3 AM from a stand where the grill is still smoking, surrounded by a crowd of night owls debating art.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a real local by how they roll their eyes at tourists struggling to parallel park on 24th. It's like watching a slow-motion train wreck.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a Muni driver stop to rescue a lost dog on the tracks today. The whole bus cheered. Only in SF do we prioritize pups over punctuality.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just pop into a local 'taverna' and blend in. But you’ll know it’s real when you hear them shout for their 'café amb llet' like it’s an art form.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by their bewilderment when they miss the pedestrian-only times on Carrer de Verdi, just standing there, confused.
